title: EU Initiatives
definition: The European Union's strategic policy framework aimed at achieving climate neutrality by 2050 through legislative, economic, and technological interventions, primarily anchored by the European Green Deal.
importanceInUpsc: EU initiatives serve as global benchmarks for environmental governance, carbon pricing, and circular economy models, frequently appearing in Prelims (Environment/IR) and Mains (GS-III Environment/Economy).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of EU Initiatives.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
